title: 7 AI-Powered Document Fraud Detection Tools for Enterprise Onboarding
slides: Can your onboarding process spot a forged document?
AI tools now detect fraud in seconds, not days
But they flag innocent errors as fraud too often
Review flagged cases manually before rejecting applicants
Test one tool on your worst fake ID case
thread_text:
1. The 48-Hour Onboarding Gap

A single forged utility bill slips through manual review, and a fraudster gets a corporate laptop by Friday. Your hiring team never sees it coming.

2. AI Flags Too Many Innocent Errors

False positives hit 30% on blurry photos or nicknames. One rejected applicant was just a woman whose married name didn't match her ID.

3. The Manual Review Rule

Never auto-reject a flagged case. A two-minute human check before the rejection email saves you from a discrimination lawsuit.

4. Test on Your Worst Fake

Take the most obvious fake ID you've ever seen and run it through one AI tool. If it fails that, don't buy it.

5. Try This Today

Take a real onboarding file from last month and run it through a free AI fraud detector. Did it flag anything you missed?
